correctness.rationale: The first-step equilibrium h=λ P h with pinned unit sources is uniquely solvable since 0<λ<1. On each wheel rim gap of m edges, the degree-three linear recurrence has unique interior values cx+(1-cx)p_{m,j}, with c=λ/(3-2λ). Summing all gaps yields the hub value X=λ(k+Q)/[n-λc(n-k-Q)] and the worst support min(X,cX+(1-cX)ψ_M); selecting the hub sets x=1. The gap-sum q_m is strictly concave, so equalizing gaps strictly increases X and never reduces the worst rim floor; thus exactly cyclically balanced profiles optimize the hub-free fixed-k problem. In the hub-selected case every pattern with maximum gap L=ceil(n/k) is optimal. Rooted-gap composition counts n*binom(k,b)/k and (n/k)[x^n](x+...+x^L)^k are valid integer counts for labelled rim sets. An independently written exact Fraction linear-system solver enumerated every nonempty source set for n=4..7 and λ=1/2,4/5 and verified the formula and optimizer-class conditions; no finite test substitutes for all-n analytic strict concavity. At n=4 λ=1/2 τ=1/3, the two opposite-rim pairs are only minimum placements.

originality.rationale: The October 25 published wheel theorem already establishes the same model, wheel all-parameter discounted hitting domination number, balanced *existence* as optimizer in both hub states, and a hub-excluding optimum at a different parameter. Full prior proof inspected. The present theorem must not claim those ingredients as original. However that earlier theorem explicitly does NOT classify all maximizers, and supplies no complete labelled optimizer counts; the submitted strict hub-free balancing uniqueness, all hub-included max-gap patterns, and two explicit counting formulas are stronger, motivated remaining claims. Neither generic Allagan discounted domination theory nor a cycle/spider result implies these complete wheel optimizer classes. O passes on the genuinely new all-optimizer classification, with significant partial coverage documented; no repair of a false claim is needed as the final theorem states the stricter classification and agrees with the prior value formulas.
residual_risks: Value formula and existence of balanced optimizers were already proved October 25; acceptance applies to the additional complete optimizer classes/counts only.
Earlier literature outside the inspected wheel theorem might include complete optimizer counts under another potential-theory terminology.
